title: What Is a Motor Top-2 Rate in Boat Racing? What It Measures and When It Changes
description: A motor's top-2 rate is the share of races that motor finished 2nd or better. The race-card value covers up to one year since the motor went into service and is fixed on the first day of the meet. With Toda Race 1 as an example, we compare it with the racer's rates and Ryujin Radar's power index.
